description: This Swift source file defines a utility enum `MicRefreshSupport` that provides functions for handling microphone refresh logic, including starting observation, scheduling refresh tasks, selecting microphone names, and binding voice wake preferences within an app. It interacts with audio input devices, task scheduling, and app state.

methods.name: startObserver
methods.description: Starts observing an audio input device, triggering a refresh callback when an event occurs.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a refresh action to execute after a delay, cancelling any previous scheduled task.

methods.name: selectedMicName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the selected microphone device from a list based on its ID.

methods.name: voiceWakeBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for voice wake feature, synchronized with application state.
